Messages.Author: Wedge
Messages.Body:
If Renewed Vigor is played on my vampire with three Orun by my
grandpredator...

Does Xe gain 6 blood more than Capacity on card?
When does the blood flow off?
Is there a window for me to tap the Heidelberg to move the excise?

Orun

Master: trifle. Put this card on a laibon.
* For non-
orun cards played by methuselahs other than this laibon`s controller,
this Laibon is considered to have 2 additional capacity. *

A Laibon gets an additional vote for every three orun he or she has.
If this laibon succesfully bleeds for more than 2 or succesfully
performs a (D) action against a non-mortal minion, he or she burns one
orun. Burn this card if this Laibon has more Orun and Aye than his
capacity.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Jul 16, 1:01 pm, Wedge <matt...@gmail.com> wrote:
> If Renewed Vigor is played on my vampire with three Orun by my
> grandpredator...
>
> Does Xe gain 6 blood more than Capacity on card?

Yes.

> When does the blood flow off?

Immediately.

> Is there a window for me to tap the Heidelberg to move the excise?

No.

Similar case would be simply hunting while at capacity. The "extra"
blood cannot be scattered by Heidelberg before draining off.

(This would be true even under Heidelberg's original function, in
which it could be used during an action -- as it is now, the gap is
even bigger).
